content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text says the cited verses were answered and rules the point underdetermined, so it does not count any verse as an unanswered witness.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.","rule_words":"A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.","room":"'counts as an unanswered witness' — one reading applies the quote-and-name requirement to any verse used against a link; the other applies it only when the judge is actually counting a verse as an unanswered witness.","why":"Because the judge expressly treats the matter as answered rather than counting a verse as an unanswered witness, K-G4 does not make this text a breach."}
